title: B2B SaaS customer success manager
description: A 5-year B2B SaaS customer success manager (onboarding, renewals, Gainsight, Salesforce) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong enterprise CSM match with SQL/BI/enterprise-segment gaps, one neighboring mid-market CSM role, one keyword-stuffed outbound SDR trap, one marginal support team lead, and four unrelated distractors.
rationale: A non-tech customer success scenario whose relevance signal is CS-domain vocabulary, not an engineering stack. j3 is the keyword trap: an outbound cold-calling SDR role at a company that SELLS customer-success software, so the posting is stuffed with the resume's exact vocabulary (customer success, retention, churn, health scores, QBRs, Gainsight, Salesforce) while the actual job family is high-volume outbound sales — TF-IDF over-ranks it, and it must stay at grade 0. Gap target j1 is a grade-3 enterprise CSM role overlapping heavily on onboarding, renewals, Gainsight, Salesforce, and QBRs, but it requires SQL for customer data analysis the resume lacks, an enterprise book the resume has only partially touched (mid-market, largest account $180K ARR), and prefers Tableau/Looker dashboards the resume has never built. j2 is a neighboring mid-market CSM role graded 2. j4 probes the graded boundary: a support team lead with real Zendesk/SaaS overlap but a different job family (support operations, not customer success).

resume.summary: Customer success manager with 5 years in B2B SaaS, owning the full post-sale journey from onboarding through renewal for a mid-market book. Finished FY2025 at 96% gross revenue retention using Gainsight health scoring and playbook-driven onboarding. Comfortable presenting adoption and ROI stories to VP-level stakeholders.

Sourced and handed off $340K in expansion pipeline by mining product usage data for upsell signals
Run 120+ quarterly business reviews per year, presenting adoption metrics and ROI summaries to VP-level stakeholders

Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Clearharbor (Hybrid, Denver CO)

Clearharbor's workforce-management platform serves 400 companies, and our enterprise segment is growing 40% a year. We are hiring an Enterprise CSM to own our largest relationships.

What you will do:
- Own onboarding, adoption, and renewal for a book of 20 enterprise accounts ($4M ARR)
- Run executive business reviews with C-level sponsors twice a year per account
- Monitor Gainsight health scores and intervene early on churn risk
- Build your own account-usage analyses by querying product data directly

Requirements: onboarding program design, renewal forecasting and negotiation, Gainsight, Salesforce, and working SQL for customer data analysis. 5+ years in B2B SaaS customer success and 2+ years owning enterprise accounts ($250K+ ARR). Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have: Tableau or Looker, customer advocacy program experience, HR tech industry background.

Sales Development Representative — RetentionIQ (Onsite, Austin TX)

RetentionIQ sells a customer success platform that helps SaaS companies fight churn and grow net revenue retention. Our SDR team opens doors for account executives.

You will make 60-80 outbound cold calls per day to VPs of Customer Success, pitch how RetentionIQ improves onboarding, renewals, and churn prevention, book discovery meetings, and log every touch in Outreach.

Requirements: high-volume cold calling, outbound prospecting, objection handling, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce. Familiarity with customer success vocabulary — retention, churn, health scores, QBRs, Gainsight — helps you speak the buyer's language. 1+ years in an SDR or BDR role, or a strong drive to start a sales career. Bonus: Outreach or Salesloft experience.
